title: Avocado Cream for Sensitive Skin in Summer: How to Use It Gently
ex: Heat, sweat and AC make sensitive skin react. Here is how to use avocado cream in summer: thin layers, night-time use, humidity tweaks and a proper patch test.
rt: Avocado Cream for Sensitive Skin in Summer | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado cream in summer for sensitive skin: how to patch test, use thin layers at night, adjust for humidity and AC, and know when to stop or get help.
quick: Sensitive skin can use avocado cream in summer if you patch test first and keep it to a thin layer at night. Use less on humid days, a little more if you sleep in AC, and wear a gentle SPF 30+ sunscreen every morning.
facts: Patch test for two to three nights before using it on the face.
Half a pea-sized amount is enough in summer.
Very humid days need only a thin layer on the cheeks.
Stop if burning, redness or itching lasts.
